title: Blackbox Exporter (HTTP + ICMP)
description: Blackbox exporter dashboard: HTTP probes (status, SSL, durations) and ICMP probes (ping RTT, packet loss, jitter).

panels.title: Uptime (period)
panels.description: Share of successful probes over the selected time range

panels.title: Avg HTTP duration
panels.description: Average total HTTP probe duration (successful probes)

targets.expr: avg((probe_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} and on(job, instance) probe_http_status_code) and on(job, instance) (probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} == 1))
avg(probe_icmp_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", phase="rtt"} and on(job, instance) (probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} == 1))

panels.title: Next SSL expiry
panels.description: Days left before the soonest certificate expires

panels.title: Status history (UP / DOWN) - all probes
panels.description: Red = probe failed (HTTP non-2xx / timeout, or ping lost).

targets.expr: probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} and on(job, instance) probe_http_status_code
avg_over_time(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]) * 100 and on(job, instance) probe_http_status_code
(1 - avg_over_time(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) * $__range_s and on(job, instance) probe_http_status_code

panels.title: HTTP status code history
panels.description: Real status code returned to the prober (even when the probe fails, e.g. 502). 0 = no response at all.

panels.title: HTTP Probe Duration
panels.description: How long the HTTP probe took to complete (sum of all phases and redirects).

targets.expr: probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} and on(job, instance) probe_icmp_duration_seconds
probe_icmp_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", phase="rtt"} and on(job, instance) (probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} == 1)
avg_over_time(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]) * 100 and on(job, instance) probe_icmp_duration_seconds
(1 - avg_over_time(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) * $__range_s and on(job, instance) probe_icmp_duration_seconds

panels.title: Ping latency (RTT)
panels.description: Round-trip time. Failed pings appear as gaps, not as 0.

targets.expr: probe_icmp_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", phase="rtt"} and on(job, instance) (probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} == 1)

panels.title: Packet loss (5 min window)
panels.description: Percentage of failed pings over a sliding 5-minute window.

targets.expr: (1 - avg_over_time(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) * 100 and on(job, instance) probe_icmp_duration_seconds

panels.title: Jitter (5 min std. deviation)
panels.description: Standard deviation of RTT over 5 minutes: higher = less stable link.

targets.expr: stddev_over_time((probe_icmp_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", phase="rtt"} and on(job, instance) (probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} == 1))[5m:])

panels.title: HTTP Probe Phases Duration
panels.description: Duration of the HTTP request by phase, summed over all redirects
